Purpose: Create dose-specific summary forest plots from saved R meta-analysis results

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
rm(list=ls())

library(haven)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rlang)

library(forestplot)
```

# Fig set up
```{r}
library(grid)

if (!dir.exists("forestplot_rd_comb")) dir.create("forestplot_rd_comb")

figpath <- here("forestplot_rd_comb/")
```


```{r}
# read in data/03_percMA_rd_drug_group1.RData created from 03_percMA_rd.Rmd
load("data/03_percMA_rd_drug_group1.RData")


# Define ordered factor levels for ae_term
ae_term_levels <- c(
  "URTI: Nasopharyngitis", "URTI: Sinusitis", "URTI: Sinusitis, acute", 
  "URTI: Rhinitis", "URTI: Rhinitis, allergic",
  "URTI: Pharyngitis", "URTI: Location not noted", "URTI: Location not noted, viral", 
  "LRTI: Bronchitis", "LRTI: Pneumonia", "LRTI: Location not noted", 
  "RTI: Location not noted", "RTI: Location not noted, viral",  
  "Cough", 
  "Other respiratory harms"
)

# Define ordered factor levels for time_frame
time_frame_levels <- c("0-6 months", "7-12 months", "13-24 months", "> 24 months")

# For forest plots, we are restricting to outcomes with at least 3 studies
dat_fig <- meta_summary_df %>%
  filter(Number_of_Studies >= 3) %>%
  mutate(ae_term = factor(Outcome, levels = ae_term_levels, ordered = TRUE),
         time_frame = factor(Timepoint, levels = time_frame_levels, ordered = TRUE),
         upper = round(Upper_CI * 100, digits = 1),
         lower = round(Lower_CI * 100, digits = 1),
         mean = round(RD_Estimate * 100, digits = 1),
         rd_ci = paste0(mean, " (", lower, ", ", upper, ")"),
         Number_of_Studies = as.character(Number_of_Studies),
         highlight = (Upper_CI < 0 & Lower_CI < 0) | (Upper_CI > 0 & Lower_CI > 0)
         )

# Set the upper and lower bounds for the x-axis
upper_limit <- 6
lower_limit <- -10
by_interval <- 2
```

```{r}
table(dat_fig$Drug)
```

```{r}
lira_drugs <- c("Liraglutide 1.2 mg", "Liraglutide 1.8 mg", "Liraglutide 3.0 mg")
dat_fig_lira <- dat_fig %>% 
  filter(Drug %in% lira_drugs) %>%
  mutate(Drug = factor(Drug, levels = lira_drugs, ordered = TRUE))

sema_drugs <- c("Semaglutide 1.0 mg", "Semaglutide 2.4 mg", "Semaglutide 14 mg (OD)")
dat_fig_sema <- dat_fig %>% 
  filter(Drug %in% sema_drugs) %>%
  mutate(Drug = factor(Drug, levels = sema_drugs, ordered = TRUE))

tirz_drugs <- c("Tirzepatide 5 mg", "Tirzepatide 10 mg", "Tirzepatide 15 mg")
dat_fig_tirz <- dat_fig %>% 
  filter(Drug %in% tirz_drugs) %>%
  mutate(Drug = factor(Drug, levels = tirz_drugs, ordered = TRUE))

dat_fig_nabu <- dat_fig %>% 
  filter(Drug %in% c("Naltrexone 32 mg/Bupropion 360 mg"))
```


# Function to output figure by drug
```{r}
make_forestplot <- function(data, suffix, figpath = "./", fig_height = 16, fig_width = 8,
                            show_footnote = TRUE,
                            footnote_text = "**Statistically significant risk difference (95% CI does not include 0). \nAbbreviations: URTI: upper respiratory tract infection; LRTI: lower respiratory tract infection; RTI: respiratory tract infection.") {
  
  # Sort data
  data_ordered <- data %>%
    arrange(Drug, ae_term, time_frame)
  
  forest_list <- list()
  
  for (drug in unique(data_ordered$Drug)) {
    drug_data <- data_ordered %>% filter(Drug == drug)
    
    # Drug-level summary row
    forest_list[[length(forest_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      label = drug,
      Number_of_Studies = "",
      mean = NA, lower = NA, upper = NA,
      rd_ci = "",
      is.summary = TRUE,
      highlight = FALSE
    )
    
    for (ae in unique(drug_data$ae_term)) {
      ae_data <- drug_data %>% filter(ae_term == ae)
      
      # Outcome-level summary row
      forest_list[[length(forest_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        label = paste0("  ", ae),
        Number_of_Studies = "",
        mean = NA, lower = NA, upper = NA,
        rd_ci = "",
        is.summary = TRUE,
        highlight = FALSE
      )
      
      # Actual data rows
      ae_rows <- ae_data %>%
        mutate(
          label = paste0("    ", Timepoint),
          is.summary = FALSE,
          highlight = (Upper_CI < 0 & Lower_CI < 0) | (Upper_CI > 0 & Lower_CI > 0),
          rd_ci = paste0(round(RD_Estimate * 100, 1), " (",
                         round(Lower_CI * 100, 1), ", ",
                         round(Upper_CI * 100, 1), ")"),
          mean = round(RD_Estimate * 100, 1),
          lower = round(Lower_CI * 100, 1),
          upper = round(Upper_CI * 100, 1)
        ) %>%
        select(label, Number_of_Studies, mean, lower, upper, rd_ci, is.summary, highlight)
      
      forest_list[[length(forest_list) + 1]] <- ae_rows
    }
  }
  
  # Combine and finalize
  forest_df <- bind_rows(forest_list) %>%
    mutate(label = ifelse(highlight, paste0(label, " **"), label))
  
  labeltext <- cbind(
    Label = forest_df$label,
    `# Studies` = forest_df$Number_of_Studies,
    `Risk Difference % (95% CI)` = forest_df$rd_ci
  )
  
  labeltext <- rbind(
    c("Drug/Outcome/Study durations", "# Studies", "Risk Difference % (95% CI)"),
    labeltext
  )
  
  data_matrix <- forest_df %>% select(mean, lower, upper)
  data_matrix <- rbind(c(NA, NA, NA), data_matrix)
  
  is_summary <- c(TRUE, forest_df$is.summary)
  
  # Create the plot
  forest_plot <- forestplot(
    labeltext,
    mean = data_matrix$mean,
    lower = data_matrix$lower,
    upper = data_matrix$upper,
    is.summary = is_summary,
    xlab = "Risk Difference % (Drug-Placebo)",
    xticks = seq(lower_limit, upper_limit, by = by_interval),
    xlim = c(lower_limit, upper_limit),
    lineheight = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    boxsize = 0.5,
    txt_gp = fpTxtGp(
      label = gpar(cex = 0.8),
      xlab  = gpar(cex = 0.8, fontface = "bold"),
      ticks = gpar(cex = 0.6, fontface = "plain", col = "black")
    ),
    fn.ci_norm = forestplot::fpDrawDiamondCI,
    fn.ci_sum = forestplot::fpDrawSummaryCI,
    col = fpColors(box = "steelblue", line = "darkgrey", summary = "steelblue"),
    lwd.ci = 2,
    lwd.zero = 2,
    lwd.xaxis = 2,
    lwd.summary = 2,
    xlog = FALSE
  )
  
  # Save the plot
  # filename <- paste0(figpath, "forest_rd_", suffix, ".tiff")
  # jpeg(
  #   filename = filename,
  #   width = fig_width,
  #   height = fig_height,
  #   units = "in",
  #   res = 400,
  #   compression = "lzw"
  # )
  filename <- paste0(figpath, "forest_rd_", suffix, ".jpeg")
  jpeg(width = fig_width, 
       height = fig_height, 
       units = 'in', 
       res = 500, 
      quality = 100, 
      filename = filename)
  
  print(forest_plot)
  
  # Conditionally add footnote
   if (show_footnote && !is.null(footnote_text) && footnote_text != "") {
    grid.text(footnote_text, 
              x = unit(0.01, "npc"), y = unit(0.02, "npc"), just = "left", 
              gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))
  }
  
  # Close the device
  dev.off()
}

```



# Liraglutide
```{r}
make_forestplot(dat_fig_lira, suffix = "lira", figpath = figpath)
```

# Semaglutide
```{r}
make_forestplot(dat_fig_sema, suffix = "sema", figpath = figpath, fig_height = 12)
```
# Tirzepatide
```{r}
make_forestplot(dat_fig_tirz, suffix = "tirz", figpath = figpath, fig_height = 4, 
                footnote_text = "Abbreviations: URTI: upper respiratory tract infection; LRTI: lower respiratory tract infection.")
```

```{r}
make_forestplot(dat_fig_nabu, suffix = "nabu", figpath = figpath, fig_height = 3.1, fig_width=8.3,
                footnote_text = "**Statistically significant risk difference (95% CI does not include 0). Abbreviation: URTI: upper respiratory tract infection.")
```


# Test code - Liraglutide
```{r}
# Create a data frame with labels and statistics
dat_lira_order <- dat_fig_lira %>%
  arrange(Drug, ae_term, time_frame)

forest_list <- list()

for (drug in unique(dat_lira_order$Drug)) {
  drug_data <- dat_lira_order %>% filter(Drug == drug)

  # Drug-level summary row
  forest_list[[length(forest_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    label = drug,
    Number_of_Studies = "",
    mean = NA, lower = NA, upper = NA,
    rd_ci = "",
    is.summary = TRUE,
    highlight = FALSE
  )

  for (ae in unique(drug_data$ae_term)) {
    ae_data <- drug_data %>% filter(ae_term == ae)

    # Outcome-level summary row
    forest_list[[length(forest_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      label = paste0("  ", ae),
      Number_of_Studies = "",
      mean = NA, lower = NA, upper = NA,
      rd_ci = "",  # Empty for summary
      is.summary = TRUE,
      highlight = FALSE
    )

    # Actual data rows
    ae_rows <- ae_data %>%
      mutate(label = paste0("    ", Timepoint),
             is.summary = FALSE) %>%
      select(label, Number_of_Studies, mean, lower, upper, rd_ci, is.summary, highlight)

    forest_list[[length(forest_list) + 1]] <- ae_rows
  }
}

# Combine into one data frame
forest_df <- bind_rows(forest_list) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(highlight, paste0(label, " **"), label))


# Build label matrix with 2 columns: Timepoint label + RD (CI)
labeltext <- cbind(
  Label = forest_df$label,
  `# Studies` = forest_df$Number_of_Studies,
  `Risk Difference % (95% CI)` = forest_df$rd_ci
)

# Add column headers as the first row in the labeltext matrix
labeltext <- rbind(
  c("Drug/Outcome/Study durations",
    "# Studies",
    "Risk Difference % (95% CI)"),
  labeltext
)

# Also add matching NA row for forest data
data_matrix <- forest_df %>% select(mean, lower, upper)
data_matrix <- rbind(c(NA, NA, NA), data_matrix)

# Add to is.summary
is_summary <- c(TRUE, forest_df$is.summary)

```


```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=16}
forestplot(labeltext,
           mean = data_matrix$mean,
           lower = data_matrix$lower,
           upper = data_matrix$upper,
           is.summary = is_summary,
           xlab = "Risk Difference % (Drug-Placebo)",
           xticks = seq(lower_limit, upper_limit, by = 3),
           lineheight = unit(0.5, "cm"),
           boxsize = 0.5,
           txt_gp = fpTxtGp(label = gpar(cex = 0.8),
                            xlab  = gpar(cex = 0.8, fontface = "bold"),
                            ticks = gpar(cex = 0.6, fontface = "plain", col = "black")),
           fn.ci_norm = forestplot::fpDrawDiamondCI,      # diamonds for regular rows
           fn.ci_sum = forestplot::fpDrawSummaryCI,       # default wide bar for summaries
           col = fpColors(box = "steelblue",
                          line = "darkgrey",
                          summary = "steelblue"),
           lwd.ci = 2,
           lwd.zero = 2,
           lwd.xaxis = 2,
           lwd.summary = 2,
           xlog = FALSE
           )
```
